description.zh:
◆ 非在野状态时，采用默认策略【常胜将军】


◆ 个人被俘概率降低

◆ 在军团战中统领的小队移动速度增加30%


◆ 在军团战中统领的近战小队攻击力增加10%

◆ 在武斗中攻击力提高10%，速度提高15%
description.en:
◆ When not Free, adopt default Strategy 【Ever-Victorious General】





◆ Reduced chance of personal capture



◆ +30% Move Speed for commanded squads in Legion Battles





◆ +10% Attack for commanded Melee squads in Legion Battles



◆ +10% Attack and +15% Speed in Combat

description.zh: 每个月每座城市的民心提升25点。
description.en: Popularity in every city increases by 25 per month.

description.zh: 消耗一个月时间，使某势力的县城，港口和关口的攻防增益下降100%，持续两个月
description.en: Spend 1 month to reduce the attack and defense buffs of a target Faction's towns, ports, and Passes by 100% for 2 months.

description.zh: 执行治安和巡访时效率提升15%。
description.en: Order and Outreach efficiency increased by 15%.

description.zh: 每个月城市治安自动提高60点。
description.en: City Order automatically increases by 60 per month.

description.zh: 某相邻非同盟势力的部队一旦抵达我方城市，会立刻撤退，持续两个月
description.en: Whenever troops from an adjacent non-Alliance Faction arrive at Our City, they will immediately retreat. Lasts 2 months.

description2.zh: 瞬移120米内指定地点。消除自身所有不良状态，士气瞬间提高20点，并增加攻防速破坏各50%。
description2.en: Teleports to a designated location within 120m. Removes all debuffs, instantly boosts Morale by 20, and increases ATK, DEF, SPD, and Siege ATK by 50%.

description2.zh: 对自身50米范围内的敌人造成2倍武力差伤害。
description2.en: Deals 2x STR-diff damage to enemies within 50m of self.

description2.zh: 快速舞动长枪，将枪气汇聚一点，朝远处的敌人冲去并造成击退效果，获得一层枪意状态。
description2.en: Rapidly spin the spear, focusing spear qi into a single point, then charge toward distant enemies to inflict knockback and gain 1 stack of Spear Intent status.

description2.zh: 流传于江湖中规中矩的中段穿刺，威力不强，但可引出后招。
description2.en: A conventional mid-level thrust passed down through the martial world. Not particularly powerful, but enables follow-up attacks.

description2.zh: 枪王童渊的终极杀招，仅有少数徒弟习得此技，对范围内所有敌人造成大量伤害，并将部分伤害转化为自身生命值和真气，并对敌人造成流血状态。
description2.en: The ultimate killing move of Spear Master Tong Yuan, mastered by only a few disciples. Deals massive damage to all enemies within range, converts a portion of the damage into HP and Qi, and inflicts Bleed on enemies.

description2.zh: 长兵绝技，虽杀伤力不强，但造成寒霜状态可对敌人形成很大牵制。
description2.en: A polearm technique with modest damage, but inflicting Frostbite greatly hinders the enemy.

description2.zh: 简单实用的枪系技巧，使敌人下回合减少1行动AP点数。
description2.en: A simple, practical spear technique that reduces the enemy's Action Points (AP) by 1 next turn.

description2.zh: 舞动兵器，聚集内力，对敌人打出致命一击。若在出牌阶段结束后还有多余行动AP，可获得额外的移动回合，且获得连破状态。
description2.en: Brandish the weapon and focus inner power to strike the enemy with a lethal blow. If any Action Points (AP) remain after the Play Phase ends, gain an additional Movement Turn and Chain Break status.

description2.zh: 长柄绝学，以长柄支撑对敌人进行连续踢击，可驱散目标敌人身上的一个正面状态。
description2.en: A polearm art using the shaft for leveraged kicks. Dispels one Buff from the target enemy.

description2.zh: 强力攻击牌，造成4.5倍杀伤，比灵魂拷问更加凶狠的绝招，发动时自身损失100点形势值。
description2.en: A devastating Attack Card. Deals 4.5x damage—a move even fiercer than ‘Soul Inquiry’. You lose 100 Momentum upon use.

description2.zh: 特殊攻击牌，在目标形势值不足1000时，形势值越低，受到的伤害越高。
description2.en: Special Attack Card. When the target's Momentum is below 1000, the lower their Momentum, the higher the damage taken.

description2.zh: 无限反击，自身闪避率和反击率提高自身武力值的20%，当闪避时恢复自身5%生命，每次回合外攻击时获得一张攻击类牌并回复自身1点行动AP。
description2.en: Unlimited Counter, own Evasion and Counter increase by 20% of own STR, recovers 5% HP when evading, and gains 1 Attack Card and recovers 1 Action Point (AP) on each Out of Turn Attack.

description.zh: 又名涯角、龙胆亮银枪，枪身如龙、枪尖如虹，若勇猛之士持之，则深陷万军之中亦可所向披靡、无人能挡。
description.en: Also called the Yajiao Spear or Dragon Courage Silver Spear. Its shaft coils like a dragon and its tip arcs like a rainbow. In the hands of a brave warrior, it is unstoppable even amid ten thousand foes.

description.zh: 在铁札甲基础上增添了披风和龙首吞肩兽，甲片的漆面做了精致的处理，据传此甲的主人有着传奇过往。
description.en: Iron lamellar armor enhanced with a cloak and dragon-head pauldrons. The plates have a finely lacquered finish, and legend says its owner had a legendary past.

description.zh: 带有金色的冲角型盔沿，散发着英气的铁盔。
description.en: An iron helm with a golden brow guard, exuding a heroic air.

description.zh: 附带【守御指挥】军魂（每次使用技能时，对自己和周围50米范围的友军添加守御状态，防御力增加15%，持续30秒钟）的宝物。厚实温润的白玉石。玉石呈长方型，即正即直，石体贯通有孔。四面皆刻有文字，有辟邪的含义。
description.en: An artifact with the 【Guard Command】 Command Spirit (each time a skill is used, grants Guard status to self and allies within 50 meters, increasing Defense by 15% for 30 seconds). A thick, warm white jade stone. Rectangular, upright and straight, with a hole bored through its center. Inscribed on all four sides with characters meant to ward off evil.

description.zh: 此马浑身上下浑然一色，通体雪白，没有半根杂毛。传说此马生下时只有脖子周围长毛，且性烈，犹如雄狮诞生一般，但长大后则会被赶出马群，后性格才会温顺。成马具有奇特气力，可踏雾登云不在话下。
description.en: This horse is uniformly snow-white all over, without a single stray hair. Legend has it that at birth it grew hair only around its neck and had a fierce temperament, like a newborn lion, only after being driven from the herd as it grew did its disposition turn gentle. As an adult, it possesses extraordinary strength, able to tread mist and mount clouds with ease.

desc.zh: 出自嬴姓，战国赵国王族支庶余脉。秦汉时期，南越王赵佗即出自此脉，其家小留在真定，成为当地望族。蜀汉重要将门。赵云为“五虎上将”之一，以忠勇闻名。其子赵统袭爵，赵广随姜维战死。家族世代为将，是蜀汉政权中后期的重要军事力量。
desc.en: Descended from the Ying surname, a cadet branch of the royal house of Zhao during the Warring States period. In the Qin and Han eras, King Zhao Tuo of South Yue hailed from this lineage, his Family remained in Zhending, becoming a prominent local lineage. An essential military house of Shu Han, Zhao Yun was one of the ‘Five Tiger Generals,’ renowned for his loyalty and valor. His son Zhao Tong inherited his title, while Zhao Guang fell in battle alongside Jiang Wei. The Family produced generals across generations, standing as a vital military pillar in the mid-to-late period of Shu Han.

name.en: Three Heroes of the Late Han

desc.zh:
枭姬困于蜀地，满腹心事无人可诉。若能寻得可信之人依靠，或许便有转机，踏上归乡之路。

禁忌条件：主角为孙尚香，刘备，关羽，张飞，赵云，诸葛亮，孙权，吴国太，周善时无法触发。

亲历条件：【与孙尚香关系等级大于2级且不足5级】、【与刘备关系等级不到5级】，【孙尚香已婚】

逆天改命：【使孙尚香成为家将，可导致阿斗死亡】
desc.en:
Trapped in the land of Shu, the Fierce Lady has no one to confide in. If she can find a trustworthy soul to rely upon, fortune may turn, and the road back home may open.



Forbidden Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Sun Shangxiang, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Sun Quan, Wu Guotai, or Zhou Shan.



Participation Conditions: 【Relationship level with Sun Shangxiang is above Level 2 and less than Level 5】, 【Relationship level with Liu Bei is less than Level 5】, 【Sun Shangxiang is married】



Defy Fate: 【Recruit Sun Shangxiang as a Retainer, may cause Ah Dou's death】

desc.zh:
返回赵府面见赵云，引二子谨奉其父教诲，静待前路启悟......

亲历条件：【身属刘禅势力】、【成都属刘禅】、【玩家武力至少为85】、【与赵云的关系至少为3级且不为亲属和夫妻】、【与赵统、赵广的关系至少为1级】

禁忌条件：主角不为赵云、赵统、赵广

逆天改命：【<答应赵云>可收赵统、赵广为家将】【<赵统、赵广完成考验>可获得赵云武魂】
desc.en:
Return to the Zhao Residence to meet Zhao Yun, guiding his two sons to heed their father's teachings and await enlightenment on the road ahead...



Participation Conditions: 【Belong to Liu Shan's Faction】, 【Chengdu belongs to Liu Shan】, 【Player STR is at least 85】, 【Relationship with Zhao Yun is at least Level 3, and not Kin or Spouse】, 【Relationship with Zhao Tong and Zhao Guang is at least Level 1】



Exclusion Conditions: Protagonist cannot be Zhao Yun, Zhao Tong, or Zhao Guang



Defy Fate: 【<Agree to Zhao Yun's request> Recruit Zhao Tong and Zhao Guang as Retainers】【<Zhao Tong and Zhao Guang complete the trial> Obtain Zhao Yun's Martial Spirit】

biography.zh: 字子龙，常山人。早年为乡中推举，率义兵投奔公孙瓒。期间与刘备相识，二人一见如故，情同手足。在公孙瓒败亡后离去，只身一人寻找刘备，自此终身追随。一生为蜀汉立功、杀敌无数，曾于长坂坡一役中七进七出、先后斩杀曹军五十余将领，救得幼主阿斗，毫发无伤归来，负有“一身是胆”的赞誉。智取桂阳时拒绝赵范寡嫂樊氏，被诸葛亮称赞为真丈夫。孙权趁刘备入川，派周善骗孙夫人带阿斗回东吴，欲以阿斗为质索荆州。子龙截江救阿斗，挫败孙权阴谋。汉中之战时，上演空营计，震慑曹军。在关张二人被害后曾力谏刘备不要攻吴。后追随诸葛亮南征北战，北伐时，已年过七旬，仍请缨为先锋，首战便力斩韩德父子五人。街亭失守后，掩护大军撤退，不久病逝。赵云被后世称为集勇武、智略、大局考量为一体的完美名将。
biography.tc: 字子龍，常山人。早年為鄉中推舉，率義兵投奔公孫瓚。期間與劉備相識，二人一見如故，情同手足。在公孫瓚敗亡后離去，只身一人尋找劉備，自此終身追隨。一生為蜀漢立功、殺敵無數，曾于長坂坡一役中七進七出、先后斬殺曹軍五十余將領，救得幼主阿斗，毫發無傷歸來，負有“一身是膽”的贊譽。智取桂陽時拒絕趙范寡嫂樊氏，被諸葛亮稱贊為真丈夫。孫權趁劉備入川，派周善騙孫夫人帶阿斗回東吳，欲以阿斗為質索荊州。子龍截江救阿斗，挫敗孫權陰謀。漢中之戰時，上演空營計，震懾曹軍。在關張二人被害后曾力諫劉備不要攻吳。后追隨諸葛亮南征北戰，北伐時，已年過七旬，仍請纓為先鋒，首戰便力斬韓德父子五人。街亭失守后，掩護大軍撤退，不久病逝。趙云被后世稱為集勇武、智略、大局考量為一體的完美名將。
biography.en: Styled Zilong, a native of Changshan. In his youth he was chosen by his fellow villagers to lead a militia force to join Gongsun Zan. There he met Liu Bei, and the two became fast friends, close as brothers. After Gongsun Zan's downfall he departed and searched for Liu Bei alone, becoming his lifelong follower. He served Shu Han with distinction, killing countless enemies. At Changban he charged seven times in and out of Cao Cao's lines, slaying over fifty enemy officers and rescuing the young lord Adou without a scratch, earning the praise of being ‘a man of pure courage.’ When he took Guiyang by stratagem, he refused the widow Lady Fan offered by Zhao Fan, and Zhuge Liang praised him as a true gentleman. When Sun Quan sent Zhou Shan to trick Lady Sun into taking Adou back to Eastern Wu as a hostage for Jing Province, Zhao Yun intercepted the boat and rescued Adou, foiling Sun Quan's scheme. During the Hanzhong campaign, he staged an empty-camp ruse that awed Cao Cao's army. After Guan Yu and Zhang Fei were slain, he urged Liu Bei not to attack Wu. He followed Zhuge Liang through the southern and northern campaigns. During the Northern Expeditions, though over seventy, he volunteered as vanguard and in his first battle slew Han De and his four sons. After the loss of Jieting, he covered the army's retreat and died of illness shortly after. Later generations hail Zhao Yun as the perfect general who combined valor, wisdom, and strategic vision.
biography.jp: 字は子龍。常山の人。若くして郷里より推挙され、義兵を率いて公孫瓚に身を寄せた。その間に劉備と知り合い、二人は一見して旧知の如く打ち解け、情同手足の間柄となった。公孫瓚の敗亡後はその元を去り、単身で劉備を探し求めて合流し、以降は生涯にわたり付き従った。生涯を通じて蜀漢に多大な功績を立て、数多くの敵を討ち取った。長坂坡の戦いでは敵陣を七度出入りし、曹操軍の将官五十余名を次々と討ち取って幼主阿斗を救い出し、無傷で帰還を果たしたことから「一身これ胆なり」と称賛された。桂陽を智取した際には趙範の寡婦となった兄嫁・樊氏との婚姻を固辞し、諸葛亮から「真の丈夫」と称えられた。孫権が劉備の入蜀に乗じ、周善を遣わして孫夫人を騙し阿斗を東呉へと連れ帰らせ、人質として荊州を要求しようとした際には、子龍が大江を遮って阿斗を奪還し、孫権の陰謀を打ち砕いた。漢中の戦いでは「空営の計」を演じて曹操軍を震え上がらせた。関羽と張飛の二人が命を落とした際には、呉を攻めないよう劉備を強く諫めた。後に諸葛亮に従って南征北戦に尽力し、北伐の折には七旬を過ぎていながら先鋒を志願し、初戦で韓徳父子五人を力戦の末に討ち取った。街亭の失陥後は大軍の撤退を援護し、間もなく病没した。趙雲は勇武、知力、大局観を兼ね備えた完璧な名将として後世に称えられている。
biography.kr: 자는 자룡(子龍), 상산(常山) 사람이다. 젊은 시절 향촌의 천거를 받아 의병을 이끌고 공손찬에게 귀부했다. 그사이 유비와 알게 되었는데, 두 사람은 첫 만남부터 옛 벗과 같았으며 정동수족(情同手足)의 의를 나누었다. 공손찬이 패망하자 그곳을 떠나 홀로 유비를 찾아 나섰고, 이후 평생토록 그를 따랐다. 평생 촉한을 위해 무수한 공을 세우고 수많은 적을 베었으며, 일찍이 장판파 전투에서 홀로 조조군 진영을 칠진칠출(七進七出)하며 조조군의 장수 50여 명을 베고 어린 군주 아두를 구출해 털끝 하나 다치지 않고 무사히 돌아와 '일신이 온통 담력으로 가득 차 있다(一身是膽)'라는 찬사를 받았다. 지략으로 계양을 평정했을 때 조범의 과수원댁 형수 번씨와의 혼인을 단호히 거절하여 제갈량에게 진정한 대장부라는 칭송을 받았다. 손권이 유비의 입촉을 틈타 주선을 보내 손부인을 속이고 아두를 동오로 데려가 인질로 삼아 형주를 되찾으려 하자, 자룡이 강을 가로막고 아두를 구출하여 손권의 음모를 좌절시켰다. 한중 공방전에서는 공영계를 펼쳐 조조군을 위압했다. 관우와 장비 두 사람이 해를 입은 후에는 유비에게 오나라를 정벌하지 말 것을 극력 간언했다. 이후 제갈량을 따라 남정북벌에 나섰고, 북벌 당시에는 이미 일흔이 넘은 나이였음에도 선봉에 서기를 자청하여 첫 전투에서 한덕 부자 다섯 명을 단숨에 베어 넘겼다. 가정이 함락된 뒤에는 본대의 퇴각을 엄호하였으나 얼마 지나지 않아 병으로 세상을 떠났다. 조운은 후세 사람들로부터 용맹과 지략, 대국을 아우르는 안목을 두루 갖춘 완전무결한 명장으로 칭송받고 있다.

raw.name: 云
raw.description: 字子龙，常山人。早年为乡中推举，率义兵投奔公孙瓒。期间与刘备相识，二人一见如故，情同手足。在公孙瓒败亡后离去，只身一人寻找刘备，自此终身追随。一生为蜀汉立功、杀敌无数，曾于长坂坡一役中七进七出、先后斩杀曹军五十余将领，救得幼主阿斗，毫发无伤归来，负有“一身是胆”的赞誉。智取桂阳时拒绝赵范寡嫂樊氏，被诸葛亮称赞为真丈夫。孙权趁刘备入川，派周善骗孙夫人带阿斗回东吴，欲以阿斗为质索荆州。子龙截江救阿斗，挫败孙权阴谋。汉中之战时，上演空营计，震慑曹军。在关张二人被害后曾力谏刘备不要攻吴。后追随诸葛亮南征北战，北伐时，已年过七旬，仍请缨为先锋，首战便力斩韩德父子五人。街亭失守后，掩护大军撤退，不久病逝。赵云被后世称为集勇武、智略、大局考量为一体的完美名将。
raw.descriptionTc: 字子龍，常山人。早年為鄉中推舉，率義兵投奔公孫瓚。期間與劉備相識，二人一見如故，情同手足。在公孫瓚敗亡后離去，只身一人尋找劉備，自此終身追隨。一生為蜀漢立功、殺敵無數，曾于長坂坡一役中七進七出、先后斬殺曹軍五十余將領，救得幼主阿斗，毫發無傷歸來，負有“一身是膽”的贊譽。智取桂陽時拒絕趙范寡嫂樊氏，被諸葛亮稱贊為真丈夫。孫權趁劉備入川，派周善騙孫夫人帶阿斗回東吳，欲以阿斗為質索荊州。子龍截江救阿斗，挫敗孫權陰謀。漢中之戰時，上演空營計，震懾曹軍。在關張二人被害后曾力諫劉備不要攻吳。后追隨諸葛亮南征北戰，北伐時，已年過七旬，仍請纓為先鋒，首戰便力斬韓德父子五人。街亭失守后，掩護大軍撤退，不久病逝。趙云被后世稱為集勇武、智略、大局考量為一體的完美名將。
raw.descriptionEn: Styled Zilong, a native of Changshan. In his youth he was chosen by his fellow villagers to lead a militia force to join Gongsun Zan. There he met Liu Bei, and the two became fast friends, close as brothers. After Gongsun Zan's downfall he departed and searched for Liu Bei alone, becoming his lifelong follower. He served Shu Han with distinction, killing countless enemies. At Changban he charged seven times in and out of Cao Cao's lines, slaying over fifty enemy officers and rescuing the young lord Adou without a scratch, earning the praise of being ‘a man of pure courage.’ When he took Guiyang by stratagem, he refused the widow Lady Fan offered by Zhao Fan, and Zhuge Liang praised him as a true gentleman. When Sun Quan sent Zhou Shan to trick Lady Sun into taking Adou back to Eastern Wu as a hostage for Jing Province, Zhao Yun intercepted the boat and rescued Adou, foiling Sun Quan's scheme. During the Hanzhong campaign, he staged an empty-camp ruse that awed Cao Cao's army. After Guan Yu and Zhang Fei were slain, he urged Liu Bei not to attack Wu. He followed Zhuge Liang through the southern and northern campaigns. During the Northern Expeditions, though over seventy, he volunteered as vanguard and in his first battle slew Han De and his four sons. After the loss of Jieting, he covered the army's retreat and died of illness shortly after. Later generations hail Zhao Yun as the perfect general who combined valor, wisdom, and strategic vision.
raw.descriptionJp: 字は子龍。常山の人。若くして郷里より推挙され、義兵を率いて公孫瓚に身を寄せた。その間に劉備と知り合い、二人は一見して旧知の如く打ち解け、情同手足の間柄となった。公孫瓚の敗亡後はその元を去り、単身で劉備を探し求めて合流し、以降は生涯にわたり付き従った。生涯を通じて蜀漢に多大な功績を立て、数多くの敵を討ち取った。長坂坡の戦いでは敵陣を七度出入りし、曹操軍の将官五十余名を次々と討ち取って幼主阿斗を救い出し、無傷で帰還を果たしたことから「一身これ胆なり」と称賛された。桂陽を智取した際には趙範の寡婦となった兄嫁・樊氏との婚姻を固辞し、諸葛亮から「真の丈夫」と称えられた。孫権が劉備の入蜀に乗じ、周善を遣わして孫夫人を騙し阿斗を東呉へと連れ帰らせ、人質として荊州を要求しようとした際には、子龍が大江を遮って阿斗を奪還し、孫権の陰謀を打ち砕いた。漢中の戦いでは「空営の計」を演じて曹操軍を震え上がらせた。関羽と張飛の二人が命を落とした際には、呉を攻めないよう劉備を強く諫めた。後に諸葛亮に従って南征北戦に尽力し、北伐の折には七旬を過ぎていながら先鋒を志願し、初戦で韓徳父子五人を力戦の末に討ち取った。街亭の失陥後は大軍の撤退を援護し、間もなく病没した。趙雲は勇武、知力、大局観を兼ね備えた完璧な名将として後世に称えられている。
raw.descriptionKr: 자는 자룡(子龍), 상산(常山) 사람이다. 젊은 시절 향촌의 천거를 받아 의병을 이끌고 공손찬에게 귀부했다. 그사이 유비와 알게 되었는데, 두 사람은 첫 만남부터 옛 벗과 같았으며 정동수족(情同手足)의 의를 나누었다. 공손찬이 패망하자 그곳을 떠나 홀로 유비를 찾아 나섰고, 이후 평생토록 그를 따랐다. 평생 촉한을 위해 무수한 공을 세우고 수많은 적을 베었으며, 일찍이 장판파 전투에서 홀로 조조군 진영을 칠진칠출(七進七出)하며 조조군의 장수 50여 명을 베고 어린 군주 아두를 구출해 털끝 하나 다치지 않고 무사히 돌아와 '일신이 온통 담력으로 가득 차 있다(一身是膽)'라는 찬사를 받았다. 지략으로 계양을 평정했을 때 조범의 과수원댁 형수 번씨와의 혼인을 단호히 거절하여 제갈량에게 진정한 대장부라는 칭송을 받았다. 손권이 유비의 입촉을 틈타 주선을 보내 손부인을 속이고 아두를 동오로 데려가 인질로 삼아 형주를 되찾으려 하자, 자룡이 강을 가로막고 아두를 구출하여 손권의 음모를 좌절시켰다. 한중 공방전에서는 공영계를 펼쳐 조조군을 위압했다. 관우와 장비 두 사람이 해를 입은 후에는 유비에게 오나라를 정벌하지 말 것을 극력 간언했다. 이후 제갈량을 따라 남정북벌에 나섰고, 북벌 당시에는 이미 일흔이 넘은 나이였음에도 선봉에 서기를 자청하여 첫 전투에서 한덕 부자 다섯 명을 단숨에 베어 넘겼다. 가정이 함락된 뒤에는 본대의 퇴각을 엄호하였으나 얼마 지나지 않아 병으로 세상을 떠났다. 조운은 후세 사람들로부터 용맹과 지략, 대국을 아우르는 안목을 두루 갖춘 완전무결한 명장으로 칭송받고 있다.
